notes.title: Minor Improvements: Update notes for March 21st
notes.content:
- Moved the mouse sensitivity slider to the options menus.  'B' no longer brings it up in game.  The sensitivity selection will now save in between levels and plays.

- We also added the ability to choose your preferred Frames Per Second within the options menus. (An FPS setting of 0 (Zero) will uncap the FPS and it will run at whatever level your PC can handle.)

- Improved the performance in the Forest and Castle levels as well as a few other levels with some culling volumes.

- Fixed an Occlusion issue which would cause the screen to flicker black when moving certain distances.

- Improved player camera stability.

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.content: - Small fix for the timer in the new Time Trials mode.

notes.title: Time Trials and Leaderboards are here!
notes.content:
Time Trials and Global Leaderboards are now live! Here’s how the features work:

[b][u]Time Trials[/u][/b]
Select the Time Trials option from the Main Menu. You must be connected to Steam to access Time Trials and Leaderboards. Navigate between leaderboard pages to select a level and start playing. You can…
-Replay races for new personal bests
-Earn medals by beating bronze, silver, and gold times
-Compete against friends and players around the world

[b][u]Leaderboards[/u][/b]
Your best time and Steam username will be automatically uploaded at the end of the race. From the finish screen, you can see the top 10 times for the level. Leaderboards for all levels are also visible in the Time Trial Level Select.

notes.title: Time Trials and Leaderboards patch notes
notes.content:
[u]Time Trials and Leaderboards[/u]
-Time Trials mode created for each original LBL level
-Time Trials level select added to Main Menu
-Global Leaderboards added for each level which show top 10 times for each
-Race times are uploaded to Leaderboards automatically at the end of races
-Note: All Time Trials levels except for 5 bonus levels are immediately unlocked. Unlock bonus levels by playing Story mode and finding collectibles. 


[u]Other[/u]
-Landscapes improved
-Regular level select improved so players can see which levels are unlocked

notes.title: Time Trials and Leaderboards in the works
notes.content:
We've started working on a Time Trials mode and accompanying Leaderboard system for Lost but Lucid! The updates will be part of a patch coming in the next couple months.

[u]Time Trials[/u]
In Time Trials mode, players will be able to play each level from the main game revised for speedrunning. Collectibles and story scrolls will be absent, and the only goal will be to get from start to finish as fast as possible. Each level will have par times to beat. 

[u]Leaderboards[/u]
After completing a time trial level, you will be able to upload your time to the global leaderboard. There will also be a menu from where you can view the top times for any level.

Stay tuned for another announcement with the release date of the Time Trials and Leaderboards!
